name: Reiko
source:
She grew up  in the tropics and is a big sister to everyone.

She may seem calm, but she is a woman of many mysteries. She'll do things randomly, like driving a car while speaking in an American Yankee accent.

[From [url=https://www.konbuni.com/nangoku.html]official site[/url]]
